ideas.title: Member onboarding brief: explain purpose, the curtain-pilot and the inventory example
ideas.description: A concise introductory brief for housing associations considering joining Common Thread that states the cooperative purpose (shared repair service), explains the concrete first step (a curtain-repair pilot planned for January), frames the shared inventory as an illustrative organising tool, and sets expectations about unresolved items (no agreed prices, savings or turnaround yet) and membership review before expansion.
ideas.audience: Other member housing associations considering participation.
ideas.rationale: Because Common Thread is presented as a cooperative for shared repair priorities rather than a separate tech business, potential members need a clear, short explanation of collective purpose, the pilot's concrete timing and scope, and what the inventory demonstrates so they can evaluate participation without assuming commercial commitments.
ideas.evidence: Two caretakers have entered sample items in a shared inventory. That inventory is intended to help a repairer locate an item and see its fabric and dimensions.

ideas.title: Operational pilot checklist and inventory template
ideas.description: A practical one-page checklist and an inventory-entry template for caretakers and repairers covering item entry fields (location, fabric, dimensions, photos), handoff steps, and a short timeline for the January pilot to reduce ambiguity about how the supporting inventory will be used.
ideas.audience: Caretakers and repairers within member housing associations responsible for the pilot.
ideas.rationale: Two caretakers have already entered sample items and the inventory is intended to help a repairer locate items, so a standardized template and checklist would make the pilot easier to run and assess.
ideas.evidence: Two caretakers have entered sample items in a shared inventory. That inventory is intended to help a repairer locate an item and see its fabric and dimensions. The pilot is planned for January and has not yet accepted repairs from tenants.

ideas.title: Decision checklist for membership commitments and future service scope
ideas.description: A short briefing for association leaders listing the outstanding governance and commercial decisions (e.g., pricing, savings estimates, turnaround expectations), the planned member review after the pilot, and the sequence for considering upholstery or other textile services.
ideas.audience: Leaders within member housing associations weighing membership and future service scope.
ideas.rationale: The source notes several unresolved items (no price list, savings estimate or turnaround promise) and that members will review pilot results before expanding services, so a decision checklist would surface the choices and timing for leaders.
ideas.evidence: No price list, savings estimate or turnaround promise has been agreed. Members will review the initial work before considering upholstery or other textile services.
